name: Banh canh Long Huong
summary: Bánh canh Long Hương is a breakfast bowl in Long Hương, Bà Rịa, not on the Vung Tau peninsula. Vietnam Airlines describes translucent white noodles in a bone broth, usually with fish cake, pork hock, or shrimp and pork, and prints 35,000–60,000 VND.
origin: Long Hương, Bà Rịa. Vietnam Airlines lists it on a Vung Tau eating article and prints 11 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám.
texture: Vietnam Airlines calls the noodles translucent, white, chewy, and soft.
taste: It calls the broth rich, from simmered bones, and finishes the bowl with herbs, scallion, and ground pepper.
howToEat: Eat it at breakfast, with herbs and pepper.
The hour is Check on arrival. This address is in Bà Rịa.
where: 11 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám, Long Hương, Bà Rịa. The hour is Check on arrival.
